paragraphs: PlanIT Geo states that it is a global urban forestry software development and consulting firm, working on urban forestry, parks, and arboriculture since 2012. The products named are the TreePlotter Software Suite together with PlanIT Geo services for urban forestry, parks, and sustainability programs. Tree canopy data is described as subscription-based and driven by artificial intelligence.

The home page names greenspace managers and tree care companies around the world as the people this urban forestry and software provider serves. Separate paths on the same page point to community programs, to businesses seeking more work, and to corporate, university, medical campus, or HOA settings. A news item on the about page quotes a city planning director on an application named TreePlotter CANOPY.

quote.text: PlanIT Geo is a full service urban forestry and software provider for greenspace managers and tree care companies around the world.
